title: A weaker judge fails right answers on one rubric
what: The wording of the off-by-one rubric's FAIL clause makes a weaker judge (Haiku) fail right answers.
why: A weaker judge fails right answers, so a measurement of it is wrong.
failing_case: the off-by-one rubric's FAIL clause words ("stays within size", "as the doc says") made Haiku fail right answers yes-03 (5 of 5) and yes-05 (2 of 5); Sonnet unaffected, the trap stays for any weaker judge (handover cause-measure)
